rows.text: on a stack record `s` with dword 0xE at s+0 and `cx` at word s+6: returns -1 when `0031C5D0(&s)` is negative; otherwise stores dword [s+0x38] at dword [rdx], word [s+0x3C] zero-extended at dword [r8], word [s+0x40] sign-extended at dword [r9], word [s+0x3E] zero-extended at the dword the fifth argument points to and word [s+0x42] sign-extended at the dword the sixth argument points to (no null tests), and returns 0
